text: Building networks for machine learning training clusters is a workload unlike anything in the earlier chapters, because the slowest link determines the speed of the entire job.
explanation: True. Thousands of accelerators exchange gradients in a tightly synchronised pattern, so a single congested path stalls everything. This has driven RDMA over Converged Ethernet, lossless fabrics with priority flow control, and in-network aggregation on programmable switches.
